_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for anything that appears in both prose and structured data. Nothing here may be duplicated as a literal in an HTML file without scripts/build-seo.mjs verifying the two agree — see the price assertion in that script. If you change a price, change it HERE and run the script; it will tell you every visible string that no longer matches.
_trialNote: trialEligibility is recorded here so it is never silently promoted into offer markup. Apple decides eligibility per Apple ID, so an Offer — which can only state unconditional terms — must not mention the trial at all. The conditional wording lives in visible copy and in terms.html.
_ratingNote: The App Store rating is NOT stored here. It is fetched from Apple on every build and published only if that fetch succeeds — a committed fallback would republish a stale number, which is the bug the generator exists to prevent. See the rating section of .scripts/build-seo.mjs.
_siteNameNote: Published as WebSite.name for entity disambiguation. A same-named app exists on the App Store; the WebSite node tells Google which entity this domain is, so keep this exact string stable and matching the App Store name.

videos._comment: YouTube is the canonical player for this video. The same cut is also on TikTok (7676336716986305822); only ONE of them is embedded and only the embedded one gets a VideoObject. Title, thumbnail, duration and upload date are fetched from YouTube at build time — nothing about the video is typed here except which video it is.
